en: A monochrome historical street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑storey residential buildings in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century style. A tram and a horse‑drawn carriage travel along tracks in the center of the street; pedestrians stand on the sidewalks, including adults and children with a pram. Leafless trees line the right side. At the top in red print is the caption "Chemnitz-Kaßberg Weststrasse". Shop signs on the buildings include a prominent corner pharmacy sign reading "APOTHEKE" and "Kassberg-Apotheke".
